description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 07.10.2019 to 13.10.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes new regulatory rates. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it constitutes a statutory instrument and regulatory framework for customs compliance.
